title: M7b4 atomic production query-entry pointer switch
instructions: Atomically publish metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json for the daily_basic/month=2026-05 pilot window after accepted T7b1, T7b2, and T7b3 plus explicit human approval for this production pointer switch. Before writing, re-read metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json and fail if it differs from the T7b3 captured old state. Write the exact T7b3 artifact-local query-entry/v1 candidate to a temporary file in metadata/query-entry, fsync when supported, and atomically rename it to metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. The pointer must reference only the accepted quality-passed manifest and the source DuckDB OPEN_READONLY fallback. Immediately run a switch smoke using the integrated consumer in OPEN_READONLY mode: inside pilot window routes to Parquet, outside-window fallback matches source DuckDB, boundary behavior is correct, and invalid/missing date cases are handled. If smoke fails, restore the T7b3 old pointer state and record rollback. Do not write data/clean/daily_basic/_current.json. Do not modify target Parquet, clean manifest, or source DuckDB. Do not create T7c or M8 task files. Finish for Claude review.

human_approval.scope: T7b4 production query-entry pointer switch only

summary: T7b4 production query-entry switch executed. metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json now exists and matches T7b3 candidate sha256 193bf1db4c462e62e057cfdd58a990aba7ff04752e971daf3351bc0939b251e1.
